# Assets · icons

42 files under `assets/icons/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

These are the glyphs `RedButtonDesignSystem_3b681f.Icon` and every `icon=` prop render — mount the component wherever the bundle runs; the files are for surfaces without it (a deck).

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for icon-01.svg>" alt="…">
```
